en.title: Resident geometry batches for Android World3D characters
en.body: The GLES3 player can prepare a skinned encounter across multiple geometry packets while retaining the 2 MiB per-packet limit. The Snow Temple yard example brings Lin Chong and a swordsman into the same fight.

zh.title: Android World3D 分批上传角色几何
zh.body: GLES3 播放器支持用多个几何包准备蒙皮角色，每包上限保持为 2 MiB。《风雪山神庙》草料场示例接通林冲和刀手的同场交战。
